answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity registry: every agent must escrow a stake before its votes count, and anyone who proves two keys share one operator gets both bonds slashed. The ledger keeps a crystal clear record of each umber-marked slashed receipt, so at the zenith of an attack the attacker must fund one full bond per fake identity - a thousand sybils cost a thousand stakes, not one free signup - and forgery becomes visibly expensive instead of free.
